claim: Inside an existing Git repository, cargo new never creates a new Git repository, regardless of the --vcs setting.
passages: Inside an existing version-control repository, cargo new defaults to creating no new version-control repository. Explicitly passing --vcs git initializes a new Git repository even inside an existing one.
